scientific_question: Before any adaptive mechanism is introduced, can fixed linear probes decode the task-relevant factors from FAS_FEATURE_V1 while query-only and cheap metadata controls remain below their sealed leakage ceilings?

scope.allowed_after_separate_probe_authorizati: Offline fitting and scoring of the static probes and negative controls defined here, using only the sealed Phase 1 v03 qualification corpus and verified Phase 2A feature cache.

data_and_split.only_dataset: FAS00_WORLD_QUALIFICATION_V03; the Phase 1 v03 corpus and no other generated worlds.
data_and_split.feature_source: Verified FULL and QUERY_ONLY rows from the Phase 2A v01 cache; cache rows contain no labels.
data_and_split.group_unit: world_seed; all families, task structures, feedback conditions, and events for one world_seed remain in one partition.
data_and_split.row_selection: Keep only rows meeting both the assigned world_seed range and assigned surface_template_id. No event-level random split, resampling, or reassignment.
data_and_split.validation_use: Locked acceptance check only. It cannot select a model, threshold, epoch, normalization, or hyperparameter.
data_and_split.test_use: One sealed held-out report after all choices and implementation hashes are frozen.
data_and_split.template_transfer: Train uses only qualification templates 3 and 4; validation and test use unseen qualification template 5.
data_and_split.world_seed_transfer: Validation and test seeds are disjoint from all training seeds and from one another.
data_and_split.class_support_gate: Every scored target class must have at least 30 examples in each validation/test slice; every fitted class must have at least 30 training examples. Otherwise fail closed as SENSOR_FAIL_NO_SIGNAL.

probe_family.model: One multinomial linear softmax probe family; logits are Wx+b and prediction is argmax, ties to the lowest integer class.
probe_family.objective: Mean multiclass cross-entropy plus (lambda/2) * squared Frobenius norm of W; bias b is not regularized.
probe_family.feature_scaling: For each fit, compute per-dimension mean and population standard deviation on that fit's training rows only; transform as (x-mean)/max(std, 1e-6). Apply the same frozen statistics to validation/test. No other normalization, clipping, whitening, PCA, or feature selection.
probe_family.optimizer: Deterministic full-batch float64 L-BFGS with fixed Wolfe line search, maximum 1000 iterations, and convergence only when infinity norm of the objective gradient is at most 1e-8.
probe_family.randomness: None in fitting; no minibatches, shuffling, early stopping, or seed search.
probe_family.implementation_hash_gate: The exact probe implementation source hash and numerical-library versions must be recorded and sealed before Phase 3 probe authorization. If the fixed optimizer does not converge, fail closed; do not change the solver or lambda in this contract.
probe_family.normalization_rationale: A single train-fitted affine scaling makes regularization scale explicit while preserving linear decodability; the rule is fixed for every probe fit and cannot be compared against alternatives.

positive_probes.label: context_term_id, the visible qualification-split context lexeme identity; do not use the arbitrary latent context_id.
positive_probes.metric: balanced accuracy over qualification context term IDs 2 and 3

positive_probes.label: entity_term_id, the visible qualification-split entity lexeme identity; do not use the arbitrary latent entity_id.
positive_probes.metric: balanced accuracy over qualification entity term IDs 4 through 7

positive_probes.label: relation_id
positive_probes.metric: balanced accuracy over the two declared query relations

positive_probes.label: exact_target in canonical candidate identity order safe=0, risky=1, idle=2.

heldout_term_transfer.purpose: Test target decoding when one context lexeme and one entity lexeme were absent from target-probe fitting; arbitrary unseen identity labels are not treated as learnable classes.
heldout_term_transfer.fit_rows: EXACT_TARGET training rows with context_term_id != 3 and entity_term_id != 7; retain only non-null observation_text.

test_slices.rows: test rows with non-null observation_text and context_term_id == 3
test rows with non-null observation_text and entity_term_id == 7

heldout_term_transfer.support_gate: At least 30 test examples for each target class in each slice; otherwise SENSOR_FAIL_NO_SIGNAL.
heldout_term_transfer.threshold_source: Reuses the sealed exact-target 0.60 balanced-accuracy threshold; no new outcome-derived threshold.

negative_controls.input: QUERY_ONLY feature view; no observation text, with the same query and canonical candidates.
negative_controls.label: exact_target, all selected test events

negative_controls.input: One-hot candidate identity permutation only; six canonical permutations, independent of target.
negative_controls.label: exact_target

confidence_interval.cluster: world_seed; each of the eight test seed groups is one bootstrap unit.
confidence_interval.sample_per_replicate: Draw eight test world_seed groups with replacement; compute their unweighted mean of per-seed accuracies.
confidence_interval.deterministic_draw: For replicate b=0..9999 and draw j=0..7, SHA-256 UTF-8 bytes 'FAS_SENSOR_CI_V01' || uint32_le(20260923) || uint32_le(b) || uint32_le(j); interpret first eight digest bytes as uint64_le and use value modulo 8 as the test-seed index.
confidence_interval.interval: Two-sided percentile interval using nearest-rank 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles; the reported upper endpoint must be <=0.45.
confidence_interval.point_estimate: Unweighted mean of the eight per-seed test accuracies; must also be <=0.40.

metrics_and_reporting.primary_metric: Balanced accuracy for positive multiclass probes; ordinary accuracy for negative target-leakage controls.
metrics_and_reporting.why: Phase 3 is static sensor qualification over the existing fixed corpus, not online adaptation or a Phase 5 temporal result.

dispositions.SENSOR_PASS: All positive gates pass on both validation and test; both held-out-term target gates pass; query-only and all metadata-only ceilings pass; cache and implementation hashes verify.
dispositions.SENSOR_FAIL_NO_SIGNAL: Any required positive probe misses its frozen threshold, solver fails, or required class support is absent.
dispositions.SENSOR_FAIL_TARGET_LEAKAGE: Query-only target control exceeds either frozen limit.
dispositions.SENSOR_FAIL_SURFACE_SHORTCUT: Any template, context/entity term, term-pair, or candidate-order control exceeds its frozen ceiling.
dispositions.non_pass_rule: Any failed, missing, invalid, or nonconverged gate blocks Phase 4/5 eligibility; no post-result repair or alternate probe is permitted under this contract.

phase_boundary.next_authorization: Separate explicit authorization is required to train and run these static sensor probes after the Phase 2A feature cache passes its own seal.
